question: What division of eight groups of eight is sought to be known fully?
premises: A division consisting of eight groups of eight is mentioned
The aim is to know this division fully
The knowledge is sought in an exhaustive manner
inference: The speaker seeks exhaustive knowledge of the division into eight groups of eight.
